lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four identifiable horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the pectoral fin attachment point, forming a semi-rectilinear grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs; the primary high-luminance blobs are localized precisely at these vertical-horizontal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient characterized by high luminance on the superior edge and a distinct shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a high-density stochastic distribution of smaller, low-diameter high-luminance points, contrasting with the larger grid-based clusters on the lateral flank.
